rationale: Pulp source commit f95ee0c4ef3b80fb6a60264319b2cfdb98ca5635 hardens crop_png allocation and row-offset arithmetic against uint32_t multiplication wrap for CodeQL alert 98. The approved exact-route projection assigns core/view/src/screenshot_compare.cpp to Generous-Corp/pulp as the pulp_implementation for harness.pixel-diff-goldens-montage, so this is a Pulp-owned visual-harness safety repair rather than a change to Vellum framework capture semantics or a backport of a named Vellum commit. The source fix is unchanged by this receipt.
